tooltip.apricityui.meta.viewport: Controls the coordinate space and scaling used to lay out this document.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.viewport.gui: Uses Minecraft GUI-scaled coordinates and follows the current GUI scale.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.viewport.browser: Uses CSS-style browser coordinates based on the window size.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.viewport.screen: Uses physical screen pixels without GUI scaling.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.viewport.fixed_g: Lays out at 427 x 249, a fixed reference size suited to GUI layouts.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.viewport.fixed_f: Lays out at 1920 x 1080 and uniformly scales the result to fit the window.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.font_mode: Selects the font renderer and the way CSS font sizes are interpreted.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.font_mode.not_se: Uses ApricityUI's default font rendering mode.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.font_mode.mc: Uses Minecraft's font renderer and native GUI text sizing.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.font_mode.web: Uses web font metrics with CSS pixel sizes.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.font_mode.web_sc: Uses web font metrics while scaling text with the document viewport.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.mouse_events: Controls whether pointer events stop at this document or pass to content behind it.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.mouse_events.pas: Allows unhandled pointer events to continue to documents or the game behind this UI.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.mouse_events.int: Stops pointer events inside this document from reaching content behind it.
tooltip.apricityui.meta.current: Preserves the custom value currently stored in this document.
